title: The reflexive hull as an intersection of localisations at height one primes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the reflexive hull of a finite module over a Noetherian normal domain as the intersection, over the height one primes, of the localisations modulo their torsion submodules, taken inside the module tensored with the fraction field. The proof works prime by prime at height one: the kernel of the localisation map into the module tensored with the fraction field is exactly the torsion submodule, the quotient is the localisation of the module modulo its torsion and is free of rank equal to the generic rank over the discrete valuation ring, and that quotient is identified with the localisation of the double dual. The intersection statement is then the content of the cited criterion for reflexivity over a normal domain.
